_README.purpose: Seed data for CATEGORY_GUIDANCE. Load into Snowflake, or import directly to mock against before the backend is up.
_README.WARNING_co2: Every embodiedCo2Kg below is an UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER, in the right order of magnitude but not cited. Replace each one with a published figure and fill in co2Source before the demo. Do not show an uncited number on screen.
_README.shape: Each entry matches the CategoryGuidance type in src/types.ts

checkTips: Check the drawer runners slide freely
Avoid particleboard that has been water damaged, it swells and never recovers
categories.note: Ideal used purchase. Solid wood desks last decades.

checkTips: Check shelves are not sagging
Confirm the wall anchor hardware is included
categories.note: Very little that can go wrong.

checkTips: Open every drawer
Check the back panel is still attached
categories.note: Heavy, so favour local pickup over shipping.

checkTips: Check the door seal grips a sheet of paper
Confirm it cools within an hour of plugging in
Look for rust inside the cooling compartment
categories.note: Canonical demo product. Common in student move-out sales every May.

checkTips: Check the door latch closes firmly
Interior should not be scorched or rusted
categories.note: A damaged door seal is the one real safety concern.

checkTips: Display a white image and look for dead pixels
Check for backlight bleed in a dark room
Confirm which cables are included
categories.note: High embodied carbon, so buying used here saves a lot.

checkTips: Confirm the edition matches the syllabus
Ask whether an access code is required and unused
categories.note: Previous editions are often fine. Ask the instructor before paying for the newest.

checkTips: Surface rust on cast iron is cosmetic and scrubs off
Check stainless pans sit flat on a counter
categories.note: Cast iron and stainless are effectively indestructible. Distinct from non-stick.

checkTips: Inspect the frame for cracks near the welds
Spin both wheels and check they run true
Chain, brake pads and tyres are cheap to replace, do not let them put you off
categories.note: Frame condition is the only thing that really matters.

checkTips: Check for cracks along the base
categories.note: No meaningful risk. Never buy these new.

checkTips: Confirm the hinges lock open
categories.note: No meaningful risk.

checkTips: Run it on every speed setting
Check the cage is not bent into the blades
categories.note: No meaningful risk.

checkTips: Ask for the battery cycle count
Confirm it powers on and passes the setup screen
Verify it is not activation locked to a previous owner's account
categories.note: The highest impact saving on this list, but activation lock makes a cheap laptop worthless.

checkTips: Sit on it and check the gas cylinder does not sink
Test that the recline lock holds
categories.note: A failed gas cylinder is a genuine repair, not a quirk.

checkTips: Inspect the seal and gasket around the blade assembly
Cracked plastic near the base means leaks
categories.note: Seals perish before motors do.

checkTips: Limescale is cosmetic and descales off
Check the flex and plug for fraying
Confirm the auto shut off works
categories.note: A failed auto shut off is the one thing to avoid.

checkTips: Budget for replacement ear pads
Test both channels before paying
categories.note: Hygiene is the reason for the caveat, not function.

checkTips: Run every zip fully up and down
Check the insulation still lofts rather than sitting flat
categories.note: Excellent value used. Flattened insulation cannot be restored.
Hygiene and pest risk, and compression is permanent. Use this one in the demo to show Verte will argue against itself.
Same reasoning as a mattress, and cheap enough that it does not sting.
Single impact protection. A helmet that has been dropped looks identical to one that has not.
The coating degrades and scratches. Point them at cast iron or stainless used instead.
Sensors expire on a fixed schedule from manufacture.
Protection components wear out invisibly with every surge absorbed.
